title.zh: 工作進度與績效檢討匯報 (SCQA 架構)

slide_title.zh: 執行摘要與今日訴求 (Executive Summary & The Ask)

zh: 情境與進度 (Situation)：本月核心 KPI 已達成 [X]%，整體專案進度符合預期
衝突與挑戰 (Complication)：受限於 [具體痛點/資源]，預期下限可能出現 [X] 延誤風險
決策訴求 (The Ask)：今日旨在同步進度，並需請主管裁示 [具體資源調配/跨部門協調]
en: Situation: Core KPIs achieved [X]%; overall project progressing as expected
Complication: Due to [Resource/Pain point], we anticipate a potential delay risk in [X]
The Ask: Sync on progress and request management decision on [Specific Resource/Coordination]

speaker_notes.zh: 老闆/各位主管好。直接切入結論，本月我們順利達標，但在下個月的規劃中遇到了一些資源瓶頸。今天匯報的重點，是希望各位了解目前的成績，並協助裁決下一階段的跨部門資源調配。
speaker_notes.en: Good morning. Bottom line up front: we hit our targets this month but foresee resource bottlenecks ahead. Today's goal is to present our results and secure your decision on cross-functional resource allocation for the next phase.

slide_title.zh: 關鍵指標分析 (Data & ROI Metrics)

zh: 業務成長 (Revenue/Progress)：本月達成 [X]，環比 (MoM) 增長 [X]%，同比 (YoY) 增長 [X]%
成本與投資回報 (Cost & ROI)：專案預算執行率 [X]%，透過 [優化措施] 成功省下 [X] 成本
品質指標 (Quality/Efficiency)：錯誤率/客訴率降至 [X]%，營運效率顯著提升
en: Growth (Revenue/Progress): Achieved [X], MoM growth at [X]%, YoY growth at [X]%
Cost & ROI: Budget execution at [X]%; saved [X] in costs via [Optimization]
Quality: Error/Complaint rate reduced to [X]%, showing significant operational efficiency

speaker_notes.zh: 讓數據說話。相比上個月與去年同期，我們的核心指標都有雙位數的成長。更重要的是，在預算控制上，我們主動優化了流程，為公司省下了不必要的開支，維持了極高的投資報酬率。
speaker_notes.en: Let the data speak. Compared to last month and YoY, our core metrics show double-digit growth. More importantly, we proactively optimized processes to cut unnecessary costs, maintaining a high ROI.

slide_title.zh: 專案里程碑與風險雷達 (Milestones & Risk Radar)

zh: 如期交付 (On-track)：[專案 A] 與 [專案 B] 達成關鍵節點，符合預期 (Under-promise, Over-deliver)
潛在風險 (Risk Radar)：[專案 C] 發現 [合規/技術] 隱患，已啟動早期預警
風險控制 (Mitigation)：已備妥 B 計畫，確保即便發生最壞情況，營運亦不中斷
en: On-track: [Project A] and [Project B] hit key milestones (Under-promise, Over-deliver)
Risk Radar: Early warning triggered for [Project C] due to potential [Compliance/Tech] risks
Mitigation: Plan B activated to ensure zero operational disruption in worst-case scenarios

speaker_notes.zh: 在專案進度上，我們秉持「早報喜、早報憂」的原則。多數項目皆超前部署；唯獨針對一項潛在風險，我們已主動標示在雷達上，並擬定了止血的 B 計畫，請主管放心。
speaker_notes.en: Regarding project timelines, we follow the 'escalate early' principle. Most items are ahead of schedule. For one identified potential risk, we have proactively flagged it and prepared a Plan B, ensuring full control.

slide_title.zh: 橫向協作與共識建立 (Cross-functional Alignment)

zh: 協作現狀：與 [部門 X] 的對接因 [客觀事實/時程] 存在瓶頸
共同利益 (Interests)：已對齊雙方終極目標皆為 [例如：提升客戶體驗/準時上線]
雙贏方案 (Win-Win)：提議透過 [資源互換/流程妥協] 解開僵局，需主管背書
en: Current Bottleneck: Handoff with [Dept X] delayed due to [Objective facts/Timeline]
Shared Interests: Realigned that both teams share the ultimate goal of [e.g., Client satisfaction]
Win-Win Solution: Proposing [Resource swap/Compromise] to break the impasse, requiring your endorsement

speaker_notes.zh: 在跨部門協作上，我們遇到了一些時程排擠。但我們沒有停留在抱怨，而是找出雙方共同的利益點。我們擬定了一個雙贏的妥協方案，只需要主管今天協助背書，就能立刻推進。
speaker_notes.en: We encountered some timeline conflicts in cross-departmental collaboration. Instead of complaining, we focused on shared interests and drafted a win-win compromise. We just need your endorsement today to move forward.

slide_title.zh: 行動計畫與期望管理 (Next Steps & Managing Up)

zh: 短期衝刺：聚焦推進 [核心任務]，承諾於 [日期] 前完成 [具體產出]
變革管理：啟動 [新流程/系統] 之團隊培訓，降低前線抗拒感
所需裁示：請求批准 [金額/資源]，我們將於 [日期] 進行下一次對焦
en: Short-term Sprint: Focus on [Core Task], committing to deliver [Specific Output] by [Date]
Change Management: Initiate team training for [New Process/System] to reduce frontline resistance
Final Ask: Request approval for [Budget/Resource]; next sync scheduled for [Date]

speaker_notes.zh: 最後，這是我們下個月的具體承諾與行動清單。同時為了確保新流程順利落地，我們也把人員培訓的變革管理考量進去。如果沒有問題，希望能取得您的資源核准。
speaker_notes.en: Finally, here is our concrete commitment and action plan for next month. To ensure a smooth rollout, we've factored in change management training. If there are no concerns, we kindly ask for your approval on the requested resources.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份專業的『月度/季度工作進度匯報』簡報。受眾為高階主管。內容需採用 SCQA 架構與 MECE 原則，著重於：1. 呈現同比/環比的業務與成本數據 (ROI)，2. 主動標示潛在風險與防錯機制 (Risk Radar)，3. 提出具建設性的跨部門雙贏方案，4. 結尾有明確的決策請求 (Call to Action)。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，每字不超過一行，語氣需展現『解決問題、管理主管期望』的將才格局。
prompt_template.en: Please create a professional 'Monthly/Quarterly Progress Report' presentation in English. Audience: Senior Management. Use the SCQA framework and MECE principles. Focus on: 1. MoM/YoY data and ROI, 2. Proactive Risk Radar and mitigation, 3. Constructive cross-functional win-win solutions, 4. A clear Call to Action at the end. Max 3 bullet points per slide, max one line per bullet. The tone should demonstrate a strong business mindset and effective upwards management.
